## Experience

- MGLogics (Dec 2021 to Jun 2026, remote): full-stack Ruby on Rails and React engineer on Shopify and BigCommerce apps, catalog and order sync, and Amazon SP-API integrations.
- SimpleDeploy (Apr 2019 to Dec 2021): backend engineer building Rails REST APIs.
- Education: B.S. in Information Technology (Software), Sindh Agricultural University, 2012 to 2017.

## Projects

- [shop_mcp_server](https://mjesar.github.io/projects/shop_mcp_server/): MCP server in Rails exposing a store's products, orders and inventory to Claude, with pgvector semantic search.
- [ai_shop_assistant](https://mjesar.github.io/projects/ai_shop_assistant/): shopping assistant using RubyLLM, Gemini and Shopify's Catalog API over MCP.
- [product_geo_agent](https://mjesar.github.io/projects/product_geo_agent/): agent that scores how discoverable a Shopify product is to AI assistants (GEO and AEO).
- [support_engineer](https://mjesar.github.io/projects/support_engineer/): Rails 8 AI support agent with human approval before actions.

## Services

Available for remote full-time roles and freelance work: AI integration for Ruby on Rails apps (MCP servers, RAG, AI agents), Shopify and BigCommerce app development, Shopify Functions and checkout customization, and e-commerce integrations and sync. Contact by email or through Fiverr (https://www.fiverr.com/mjesar).
